Name: Elishama, Son of Ammihud
Summary: Elishama, son of Ammihud, was the prince of the tribe of Ephraim at the census in the wilderness, and the grandfather of Joshua.
KeyStory: Elishama led Ephraim's 40,500 men and brought the tribe's offering for the dedication of the altar.
LifeLesson: The faith of one generation can put the next in sight of the promised land.
